name: pushraker
title: pushraker
author: noon92
description:
Push and email notifications for your print jobs: started, first layer, progress, paused, upcoming pause, complete, cancelled, errors, filament and calibrations, with a camera picture or the model preview. Sent through ntfy, Pushover, Gotify, Telegram, Discord, a webhook or email.

Every notification's title and text are editable templates, and you can write your own notifications that fire when a condition you set is true, or from G-code. Set it up on its own settings page (Notifications, under the printer's links).

The print-end and cancel pictures are taken before the printer parks: pushraker's macros run at the start of PRINT_END and CANCEL_PRINT, without changing the printer's own macros.
tagline: Notifications for your print jobs, with pictures, fully customizable.

macros.name: _PRINT_END_NTFY
macros.description: Run at the start of PRINT_END: lifts the toolhead and reports print complete, so the snapshot shows the part.

macros.name: _CANCEL_PRINT_NTFY
macros.description: Run at the start of CANCEL_PRINT: lifts the toolhead and reports the cancel, so the snapshot shows the part.
